statement.p: Zoey is an architect and she is making a scale model of a building. The actual building will be 64 ft tall. In the model, the height of the building will be 3 in tall and there will be a little model person standing next to the building. How tall should Zoey make the model of that person who is meant to represent a 5 ft 6 in tall person?

$p = randomPerson(); $building = random(30,80,2); $model = random(2,10); Context("Fraction"); $ans = $model/($building)*5.5; $answer = FormulaWithUnits("$ans in"); @aux[0] = 5.5*$model;
###### # Body ######
BEGIN_PGML [$p] is an architect and [$p->they] [$p->are] making a scale model of a building. The actual building will be [`[$building]`] ft tall. In the model, the height of the building will be [`[$model]`] in tall and there will be a little model person standing next to the building. How tall should [$p] make the model of that person who is meant to represent a [`5`] ft [`6`] in tall person?
[_]{$answer}{16}
END_PGML
########## # Solution ##########
BEGIN_PGML_SOLUTION Let [`h`] be the height of the person in [$p]'s model, which we'll measure in inches. We'll create a proportional equation that compares the building and person's heights in the model to their heights in real life:
[``` \begin{aligned} \frac{\text{height of model building in inches}}{\text{height of actual building in feet}}\amp=\frac{\text{height of model person in inches}}{\text{height of actual person in feet}}\\ \frac{[$model]\,\text{in}}{[$building]\,\text{ft}}\amp=\frac{h\,\text{in}}{5\,\text{ft}\,6\text{in}} \end{aligned} ```]
Before we can just eliminate the units, we'll need to convert 5 ft[$NBSP]*6 in to feet:
[``` \frac{2\,\text{in}}{30\,\text{ft}}=\frac{h\,\text{in}}{5.5\,\text{ft}} ```]
Now we can remove the units and continue solving:
[``` \begin{aligned} \frac{[$model]}{[$building]}\amp=\frac{h}{5.5}\\ \multiplyleft{[$building]\cdot5.5}\frac{[$model]}{[$building]}\amp=\frac{h}{5.5}\multiplyright{[$building]\cdot5.5}\\ 5.5\cdot [$model] \amp= [$building]h\\ [$aux[0]] \amp= [$building]h\\ h\amp\approx [$ans] \end{aligned} ```]
[$p] should make the model be [`[$answer]`] tall.
END_PGML_SOLUTION
